definition.en: A cough (ubo). Cough into your elbow, not your hands.
definition.fil: Ubo. Umubo sa siko, hindi sa kamay.

definition.en: Your elbow (siko). Cough or sneeze into it when you have no tissue.
definition.fil: Siko. Dito umubo o bumahing kapag walang tisyu.

definition.en: A cold or runny nose (sipon). Use a tissue and wash your hands.
definition.fil: Sipon. Gumamit ng tisyu at maghugas ng kamay.

definition.en: Sickness (sakit). When you are sick, tell a grown-up and rest at home.
definition.fil: Sakit. Kapag may sakit ka, sabihin sa nakatatanda at magpahinga sa bahay.

definition.en: Medicine (gamot). Take it only when a grown-up or a doctor gives it to you.
definition.fil: Gamot. Inumin lang kapag ibinigay ng nakatatanda o ng doktor.

definition.en: Hands (kamay). Wash them with soap often, and before you eat.
definition.fil: Kamay. Hugasan ito ng sabon nang madalas, at bago kumain.

definition.en: Water (tubig). Rinse your hands under clean running water.
definition.fil: Tubig. Banlawan ang kamay sa malinis na umaagos na tubig.

definition.en: Clean (linis). Clean hands and clean tables keep germs away.
definition.fil: Linis. Ang malinis na kamay at mesa ay naglalayo sa mikrobyo.

definition.en: Soap (sabon). Soap and water wash germs off your hands.
definition.fil: Sabon. Natatanggal ng sabon at tubig ang mikrobyo sa kamay.

definition.en: Wash (hugas). Wash your hands for 20 seconds.
definition.fil: Hugas. Maghugas ng kamay nang 20 segundo.

definition.en: A handkerchief (panyo). Cover your cough or sneeze with it, then wash it.
definition.fil: Panyo. Takpan nito ang ubo o bahing, saka labhan.

definition.en: Rest (pahinga). Resting helps your body get better.
definition.fil: Pahinga. Ang pagpapahinga ay tumutulong sa katawan na gumaling.

definition.en: Cleanliness (kalinisan): keeping yourself and your things clean so you stay healthy.
definition.fil: Kalinisan: ang pagpapanatiling malinis ng sarili at ng gamit para manatiling malusog.

definition.en: A fever (lagnat): your body is hotter than normal. Tell a grown-up, drink water and rest.
definition.fil: Lagnat: mas mainit ang katawan kaysa karaniwan. Sabihin sa nakatatanda, uminom ng tubig at magpahinga.

definition.en: Home (bahay). Stay home when you are sick.
definition.fil: Bahay. Manatili sa bahay kapag may sakit.

definition.en: A vaccine (bakuna) teaches your body to fight a germ before it makes you very sick.
definition.fil: Tinuturuan ng bakuna ang katawan na labanan ang mikrobyo bago ka magkasakit nang malubha.

definition.en: A doctor (doktor) checks you and tells you how to get well.
definition.fil: Sinusuri ka ng doktor at sinasabi kung paano gagaling.

definition.en: A germ (mikrobyo): a tiny living thing, too small to see, that can make you sick.
definition.fil: Mikrobyo: napakaliit na buhay na bagay, hindi nakikita ng mata, na puwedeng magdulot ng sakit.

definition.en: Symptoms (sintomas): signs of sickness, like a fever, a cough or a runny nose.
definition.fil: Sintomas: mga palatandaan ng sakit, gaya ng lagnat, ubo o sipon.
